note: RhosGFX Cartoony UI pack pieces -> Godot StyleBoxes (UiSkin, ui/theme/ui_pack.json). Owned by UI slice (a): other slices use the UiTheme factories (card_box, chip_box, callout_box, inset_box, bar_boxes, toast_box, panel_box(kind, accent)) or these piece names, and never edit this file. Component map: docs/design/2026-09-30-ui-reskin.md section 2. Paths are relative to third_party/; slice = 9-slice margins in SVG units; scale = logical px per SVG unit; content / expand in logical px; fit = shrink the whole box uniformly when the rect is smaller than its slices (UiFitStyleBox) so one piece serves every size. Format: docs/design/2026-09-30-svg-ui-pipeline.md.

chip_yellow.note: Chip / pill, Flat Round 2.5 yellow-regular (64 px nominal, fit shrinks to the chip height).

chip_purple.note: Chip / pill, Flat Round 2.5 purple-regular (64 px nominal, fit shrinks to the chip height).

chip_blue.note: Chip / pill, Flat Round 2.5 blue-regular (64 px nominal, fit shrinks to the chip height).

chip_grey.note: Chip / pill, Flat Round 2.5 grey-darker (64 px nominal, fit shrinks to the chip height).

chip_white.note: Chip / pill, Flat Round 2.5 white (64 px nominal, fit shrinks to the chip height). Tint per use.

panel_pill.note: HUD counters (gold, treasury, lap, speed), toasts' old pill, Counter default: grey-darker Flat Round pill, TEXT content.

badge_count.note: Count badge: Flat Round '-1-' red circle, ink number; 28 px nominal, 1-unit stretch band so 2 digits make a pill. Sits INSIDE its tile, inset 8 px (spec 3.1).

new_dot.note: NEW dot: radio-on-red, 20 px, inside the tile's top-right corner inset 8 px (spec 2.3). Use UiSkin.texture().

tab_track.note: Segmented control / tab track (Armory groups, settings speed + UI size): Flat container grey-darker.

tab.note: Tab / segment: selected = yellow pill (ink text), normal = grey-darker pill (TEXT_DIM text).

panel_main.note: Modal frame (UiModal): Container 3D white x NAVY_2 inset 8 px under the Nailed darkbrown-dark frame, scale 1.0 like desktop (0.75 read as a thin rust-red line on phones, modal pass 2026-10-01), plank edges tile_fit.

panel_main_lg.note: Modal frame (UiModal): Container 3D white x NAVY_2 inset 8 px under the Nailed darkbrown-dark frame, scale 1.0 (canvas >= 1000 logical px both ways), plank edges tile_fit.

panel_tray.note: Dice tray frame (slice b): Nailed darkbrown-dark over a NAVY fill at alpha .85.

panel_tray_thin.note: Dice tray frame on short screens (slice b, spec 4.2): a Thin darkbrown-dark rim over the NAVY .85 fill.

plaque_yellow.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 yellow-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_red.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 red-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_purple.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 purple-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_green.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 green-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_blue.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 blue-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_forestgreen.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 forestgreen-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_pink.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 pink-regular standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4).

plaque_white.note: Modal title plaque: 3D Square 2.5 white standard, 84 px nominal (72 on phone via fit), ink Lilita title; overlaps the frame top by half its height (spec 2.4). Tint per use.

panel_hud.note: HUD strip: Containers/Flat white x NAVY, alpha .78 (PANEL_SOFT).

panel_inset.note: Inset / stat well: Containers/Flat white x INK, alpha .55.

well.note: Small well behind 3D thumbnails (plan d): Frames/Inset white x INK at alpha .35.

panel_card.note: Card (CampUi.card, OptionCard, tiles): Container 3D white x NAVY_2, scale 0.8. States: hover NAVY_3; selected / worn = NAVY_3 + yellow Thin rim (inside the card); on = purple rim; craftable = yellow-dark rim; owned = NAVY_3 no rim; locked = INK at .7; dim = NAVY_2 at .6. Rims (selected / worn / on / craftable) are the card art itself in the rim colour under the face art inset 3-4 px, so the rim follows the card's rounded corners (modal pass 2026-10-01; the square Thin frame overlay did not).

card_accent.note: Accent card (rarity / class / biome): the card art x accent (per-use tint, alpha .65) under the navy card art inset 3 px: a rim that follows the card's rounded corners.

tooltip.note: Tooltip with no accent: Flat INK .97 + Thin darkbrown-dark rim, scale 0.35.

callout.note: Callout (item pop, passive / biome card, accent tooltip): Flat INK .97 + Thin white rim x accent (per-use tint = the information).

toast.note: Toast (one helper, Toast.show): callout art; rim gold = reward, red = danger, green = heal, blue = info.

tag_station.note: Camp station tag (plan d): Flat INK + Thin rim in the station colour (per-use tint).

frame_pointed.note: Enemy / danger surfaces (encounter + boss cards, slice b): Flat INK + Pointed white x affix colour (per-use tint), scale 0.6. Measured slices 57/62/61/64 keep the points in the corners' neighbours; keep these cards near the art's aspect.

frame_ornate.note: Boss-tier overlay only (boss passives, boss unlocks): Ornate yellow at scale 0.45, no centre. Draw over a card. Scale 0.3 (was 0.45: the stretched straight edges read as thick orange bars).

bar_hp.note: Hero HP (HUD): red fill, ghost drain yellow-lighter; value text white with a 4 px OUTLINE. Wide bar, 48 px nominal (scale = h / 24).

bar_block.note: Block overlay / shield. Regular bar, 30 px nominal (scale = h / 20).

bar_xp.note: XP (hero, pet XP). Regular bar, 30 px nominal (scale = h / 20).

bar_mastery.note: Mastery / goals / item mastery. Regular bar, 30 px nominal (scale = h / 20).

bar_loading.note: Loading (boot, content streaming). Thin bar, 24 px nominal (scale = h / 16).

bar_enemy.note: Enemy HP (world HUD). Thin bar, 24 px nominal (scale = h / 16).

bar_par.note: Minigame par meter; state 'over' = red when over par. Regular bar, 30 px nominal (scale = h / 20).

slider.note: HSlider: Regular grey-darker track + yellow fill at scale 1.5 (30 px), grabber handle-round 44x51 px, centre_grabber.

toggle.note: CheckButton icons (UiSkin.apply_toggle): green container + knob right / grey + knob left, composed. ToggleSwitch draws toggle_track + toggle_knob instead (animated knob).

toggle_track.note: ToggleSwitch track, 88x48 px (scale 2.0): checked = green container, unchecked = grey. Slices keep a 1-unit band.

toggle_knob.note: ToggleSwitch knob / generic round handle (UiSkin.texture('toggle_knob', 'normal', px)).

checkbox.note: CheckBox icons, 48 px (scale 2.0), 88 px hit row.

scrollbar.note: LATER (spec 2.10): rotated Thin grey-darker track + handle-square-vertical grabber. The Theme keeps flat pack-coloured StyleBoxFlat scrollbars for now (adopted); this piece is ready for the switch.

focus_ring.note: Keyboard / gamepad focus ring for non-button controls (desktop only): cursor-focus corners, slices 50, no centre, scale 0.5, drawn inset 2 px inside the control (never outward).

dev_panel.note: Developer menu frame (DevMenu only, slate direction C): Container 3D grey-darker inset 8 px under the Square Corners grey-dark frame, scale 0.625 (phone / small canvas). Never used by player-facing modals.

dev_panel_lg.note: Developer menu frame (DevMenu only, slate direction C): Container 3D grey-darker inset 8 px under the Square Corners grey-dark frame, scale 0.8 (canvas >= 1000 logical px both ways). Never used by player-facing modals.

dev_header.note: Developer menu header bar (full-screen dev surface: DEVELOPER tag, title, close): Flat white x #1b2d38 (deep slate).

dev_button.note: Developer menu secondary button (>= 80 px): 3D Square 2.5 grey-light (slate), ink labels.

dev_button_accent.note: Developer menu accent button (>= 80 px: SWITCH, channel on): 3D Square 2.5 white x muted teal #5ccfc3 (tooling accent, not the game's yellow), ink labels.

dev_button_dark.note: Developer menu toggle off (>= 80 px: channel chips): 3D Square 2.5 grey-dark, light labels.

dev_button_sm.note: Developer menu secondary button (<= 72 px): 3D Square 2.5 grey-light (slate), ink labels.

dev_button_accent_sm.note: Developer menu accent button (<= 72 px: SWITCH, channel on): 3D Square 2.5 white x muted teal #5ccfc3 (tooling accent, not the game's yellow), ink labels.

dev_button_dark_sm.note: Developer menu toggle off (<= 72 px: channel chips): 3D Square 2.5 grey-dark, light labels.

dev_inset.note: Developer menu inset (build info): Flat white x deep slate #16242d, alpha .85.

dev_callout.note: Developer menu confirm box (channel switch): Flat deep slate + Thin white rim x teal.

dev_chip.note: Developer menu DEVELOPER tag: Flat Round 2.5 white x teal (fit shrinks to the chip height).
